__broaden__.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
__broaden__.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him') · conjunction before a perfect verb, 'until' (እስከ አኅደጎሙ 'until he freed them')
__broaden__.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of') · 'by' of the father in conception (ፀንሰት እምኀበ ቈላሶን 'she conceived by Qolason')
